data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Your fund's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in SBFG and HWBK.

On September 4, 2026, HWBK filed an 8-K reporting completion of an acquisition or disposition of assets under Item 2.01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
